paragraphs.source_en: The senior retainers had long known of this arrangement and were not surprised. The women alone were astounded when they heard. By custom, the coffin should have remained within the castle for at least two days and two nights. Lord Ieyasu had only just departed this life, his body not yet cold, yet the shogun had ordered his coffin conveyed to Mount Kunō—a decision that shocked all who heard of it.

units.source_en: The senior retainers had long known of this arrangement and were not surprised.
units.source_zh: 诸重臣早就知了如此安排，并不惊讶。

units.source_en: The women alone were astounded when they heard.
units.source_zh: 唯女人们一听，无不大吃一惊。

units.source_en: By custom, the coffin should have remained within the castle for at least two days and two nights.
units.source_zh: 照例，灵柩至少应在城内停放两日两夜。

units.source_en: Lord Ieyasu had only just departed this life, his body not yet cold, yet the shogun had ordered his coffin conveyed to Mount Kunō—a decision that shocked all who heard of it.
units.source_zh: 家康公刚归天，尸骨未寒，将军便令将灵柩运到久能山，实令世人惊心。

paragraphs.source_zh: 诸重臣早就知了如此安排，并不惊讶。唯女人们一听，无不大吃一惊。照例，灵柩至少应在城内停放两日两夜。家康公刚归天，尸骨未寒，将军便令将灵柩运到久能山，实令世人惊心。

paragraphs.source_en: “What an outrageous disregard for propriety!”

units.source_en: “What an outrageous disregard for propriety!”
units.source_zh: “真是不知礼仪啊！”

paragraphs.source_zh: “真是不知礼仪啊！”

paragraphs.source_en: “Even ordinary commoners would not behave so.”

units.source_en: “Even ordinary commoners would not behave so.”

ja.t: でさえ、このようなことはしまい」

units.source_zh: “即便是寻常百姓，也不会如此。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “即便是寻常百姓，也不会如此。”

paragraphs.source_en: Shogun Hidetada, however, replied with extraordinary composure that to do otherwise would violate the instructions the Ōgosho had given in life.

units.source_en: Shogun Hidetada, however, replied with extraordinary composure that to do otherwise would violate the instructions the Ōgosho had given in life.
units.source_zh: 但，将军秀忠却道，若非如此，便是违背大御所生前的吩咐，他说得异常冷静。

paragraphs.source_zh: 但，将军秀忠却道，若非如此，便是违背大御所生前的吩咐，他说得异常冷静。

paragraphs.source_en: Toward evening, a fine, unbroken rain began to fall once more.

units.source_en: Toward evening, a fine, unbroken rain began to fall once more.
units.source_zh: 傍晚，天又下起绵绵细雨。

paragraphs.source_zh: 傍晚，天又下起绵绵细雨。

paragraphs.source_en: Hidetada presented all his own wishes as his father’s “dying commands,” and everything proceeded smoothly. Even had he not put it so, no one would have defied his orders or raised an objection. With no time even to rest, they swiftly transferred the coffin.

units.source_en: Hidetada presented all his own wishes as his father’s “dying commands,” and everything proceeded smoothly.
units.source_zh: 秀忠把自己意思均说成是父亲的“遗命”，诸事遂顺。

units.source_en: Even had he not put it so, no one would have defied his orders or raised an objection.
units.source_zh: 即便他不这般说，也不会有人违抗命令，提出异议。

units.source_en: With no time even to rest, they swiftly transferred the coffin.
units.source_zh: 大家来不及歇息，迅速转移灵柩。

paragraphs.source_zh: 秀忠把自己意思均说成是父亲的“遗命”，诸事遂顺。即便他不这般说，也不会有人违抗命令，提出异议。大家来不及歇息，迅速转移灵柩。

paragraphs.source_en: “Yoshinao, Councillor of Owari; Yorinobu, Middle Captain of Tōtōmi; and Major General Yorifusa need not go in person. Each is to send a retainer in his stead.” After issuing these instructions, Hidetada secretly dispatched another twenty mounted men under the town magistrate Hikosaka Mitsumasa to Rinzai-ji, where Kazusa-no-suke Tadateru was temporarily residing. They were to maintain strict vigilance and take the opportunity to inform him that his father had departed this life.

units.source_en: “Yoshinao, Councillor of Owari; Yorinobu, Middle Captain of Tōtōmi; and Major General Yorifusa need not go in person. Each is to send a retainer in his stead.”
units.source_zh: “尾张参议义直、远江中将赖宣、少将赖房不必亲自前往，各人派出家臣即可。”

units.source_en: After issuing these instructions, Hidetada secretly dispatched another twenty mounted men under the town magistrate Hikosaka Mitsumasa to Rinzai-ji, where Kazusa-no-suke Tadateru was temporarily residing. They were to maintain strict vigilance and take the opportunity to inform him that his father had departed this life.
units.source_zh: 秀忠这般吩咐完毕，又暗中增派町奉行彦坂光正属下的二十骑士前往上总介忠辉暂居的临济寺，严加警戒，借机告知父亲已经归天。

paragraphs.source_zh: “尾张参议义直、远江中将赖宣、少将赖房不必亲自前往，各人派出家臣即可。”秀忠这般吩咐完毕，又暗中增派町奉行彦坂光正属下的二十骑士前往上总介忠辉暂居的临济寺，严加警戒，借机告知父亲已经归天。

paragraphs.source_en: Hidetada’s reason for not allowing his three brothers to accompany the procession was quite simple. Outwardly, he said that they were young and might harm their health through excessive grief; in truth, he wanted their retainers—men accomplished in both wisdom and valor—to serve as escorts against any contingency. Yoshinao sent Naruse Hayato-no-shō Masanari; Yorinobu sent Andō Tatewaki Naotsugu; and Yorifusa appointed Nakayama Bizen-no-kami Nobuyoshi. All three had enjoyed Lord Ieyasu’s deep affection and trust.

units.source_en: Hidetada’s reason for not allowing his three brothers to accompany the procession was quite simple. Outwardly, he said that they were young and might harm their health through excessive grief; in truth, he wanted their retainers—men accomplished in both wisdom and valor—to serve as escorts against any contingency.

ja.t: えようとしたのである。

units.source_zh: 秀忠不让三个兄弟随行，理由颇为简单，表面上说他们年幼，怕他们因过度悲痛而伤身，实际上他是想令诸弟智勇双全的家臣随行护卫，以防万一。

units.source_en: Yoshinao sent Naruse Hayato-no-shō Masanari; Yorinobu sent Andō Tatewaki Naotsugu; and Yorifusa appointed Nakayama Bizen-no-kami Nobuyoshi. All three had enjoyed Lord Ieyasu’s deep affection and trust.
units.source_zh: 义直派了成濑隼人正正成，赖宣派了安藤带刀直次，赖房则令中山备前守信吉前往，诸人均备受家康公的厚爱和信赖。

paragraphs.source_zh: 秀忠不让三个兄弟随行，理由颇为简单，表面上说他们年幼，怕他们因过度悲痛而伤身，实际上他是想令诸弟智勇双全的家臣随行护卫，以防万一。义直派了成濑隼人正正成，赖宣派了安藤带刀直次，赖房则令中山备前守信吉前往，诸人均备受家康公的厚爱和信赖。

paragraphs.source_en: This transfer was not, of course, the formal funeral ceremony. It was only the conveyance of the coffin to Mount Kunō to await the appointed day of burial. Thus Tokugawa Hidetada, the chief mourner, did not accompany it; command was entrusted solely to Doi Ōi-no-kami Toshikatsu.

units.source_en: This transfer was not, of course, the formal funeral ceremony. It was only the conveyance of the coffin to Mount Kunō to await the appointed day of burial.

ja.t: つためのものであった。

units.source_zh: 此次迁座自非正式葬仪，单是将灵柩送到久能山，等待葬礼之期。

units.source_en: Thus Tokugawa Hidetada, the chief mourner, did not accompany it; command was entrusted solely to Doi Ōi-no-kami Toshikatsu.
units.source_zh: 因此，祭主德川秀忠并不随行，单由土井大炊头利胜指挥。

paragraphs.source_zh: 此次迁座自非正式葬仪，单是将灵柩送到久能山，等待葬礼之期。因此，祭主德川秀忠并不随行，单由土井大炊头利胜指挥。

paragraphs.source_en: The coffin left the castle at the Hour of the Rooster.

units.source_en: The coffin left the castle at the Hour of the Rooster.
units.source_zh: 灵柩于酉时出城。

paragraphs.source_zh: 灵柩于酉时出城。

paragraphs.source_en: Night had fallen, and scattered points of lamplight could be seen through the fine rain. The people had heard the news and knelt prostrate along the roadside to see the Chancellor of the Realm on his final journey.

units.source_en: Night had fallen, and scattered points of lamplight could be seen through the fine rain.
units.source_zh: 天已黑，绵绵细雨中，可以看见星星点点的灯火。

units.source_en: The people had heard the news and knelt prostrate along the roadside to see the Chancellor of the Realm on his final journey.
units.source_zh: 百姓已听说，纷纷跪伏路旁，恭送太政大臣。

paragraphs.source_zh: 天已黑，绵绵细雨中，可以看见星星点点的灯火。百姓已听说，纷纷跪伏路旁，恭送太政大臣。

paragraphs.source_en: At the head rode Honda Kōzuke-no-suke Masazumi, followed by Matsudaira Uemon-no-daibu Masatsuna, Itakura Naizen-no-shō Shigemasa, and Akimoto Tajima-no-kami Yasutomo. Behind them came Ieyasu’s coffin, with Doi Toshikatsu, Masanari, and the other two men guarding it closely at its sides. Konchi-in Sūden, Nankōbō Tenkai, and Shinryū-in Bonshun also accompanied the procession. Once the procession reached the foot of Mount Kunō, no unauthorized person was permitted to ascend.

units.source_en: At the head rode Honda Kōzuke-no-suke Masazumi, followed by Matsudaira Uemon-no-daibu Masatsuna, Itakura Naizen-no-shō Shigemasa, and Akimoto Tajima-no-kami Yasutomo. Behind them came Ieyasu’s coffin, with Doi Toshikatsu, Masanari, and the other two men guarding it closely at its sides.
units.source_zh: 最前面乃是本多上野介正纯，接着为松平右卫门大夫正纲、板仓内膳正重昌、秋元但马守泰朝，再往后便是家康灵柩，土井利胜和正成等三人则紧紧守卫于旁。

units.source_en: Konchi-in Sūden, Nankōbō Tenkai, and Shinryū-in Bonshun also accompanied the procession.
units.source_zh: 金地院崇传、南光坊天海、神龙院梵舜亦随行。

units.source_en: Once the procession reached the foot of Mount Kunō, no unauthorized person was permitted to ascend.
units.source_zh: 队伍到了久能山山脚下，闲杂人等便不能进山。

paragraphs.source_zh: 最前面乃是本多上野介正纯，接着为松平右卫门大夫正纲、板仓内膳正重昌、秋元但马守泰朝，再往后便是家康灵柩，土井利胜和正成等三人则紧紧守卫于旁。金地院崇传、南光坊天海、神龙院梵舜亦随行。队伍到了久能山山脚下，闲杂人等便不能进山。

paragraphs.source_en: That night, apart from Sakakibara Dainaiki Kiyohisa, who had already returned to the mountain, only the few favored retainers of Lord Ieyasu named above kept vigil beside his spirit.

units.source_en: That night, apart from Sakakibara Dainaiki Kiyohisa, who had already returned to the mountain, only the few favored retainers of Lord Ieyasu named above kept vigil beside his spirit.
units.source_zh: 是夜，侍奉于家康公灵侧的，除了先前已回到山中的神原大内记清久，便只有前面所述的几个家康公宠臣。

paragraphs.source_zh: 是夜，侍奉于家康公灵侧的，除了先前已回到山中的神原大内记清久，便只有前面所述的几个家康公宠臣。

paragraphs.source_en: On the eighteenth, dawn came amid the sound of hammers and chisels building the shrine, muffled in the morning mist after the rain. Only when the sky cleared could they see that this was indeed an auspicious site blessed with a broad and commanding view.

units.source_en: On the eighteenth, dawn came amid the sound of hammers and chisels building the shrine, muffled in the morning mist after the rain.
units.source_zh: 十八日，筑建神殿的锤凿之声，在雨后的晨雾中迎来了黎明。

units.source_en: Only when the sky cleared could they see that this was indeed an auspicious site blessed with a broad and commanding view.
units.source_zh: 天晴之后方知，此地实为一处视野开阔的风水宝地。

paragraphs.source_zh: 十八日，筑建神殿的锤凿之声，在雨后的晨雾中迎来了黎明。天晴之后方知，此地实为一处视野开阔的风水宝地。

paragraphs.source_en: To the southwest, the sea stretched in a sweep of blue, merging with the distant sky; to the right, the waters of Suruga curved around and seemed to frolic with the ocean.

units.source_en: To the southwest, the sea stretched in a sweep of blue, merging with the distant sky; to the right, the waters of Suruga curved around and seemed to frolic with the ocean.
units.source_zh: 西南面的大海一片蔚蓝，和远天连成一片，右边骏河水拐过一个弯，与海水相互嬉戏。

paragraphs.source_zh: 西南面的大海一片蔚蓝，和远天连成一片，右边骏河水拐过一个弯，与海水相互嬉戏。

paragraphs.source_en: The beauty of the scene made one instinctively fall still and listen to the low murmur of all creation.

units.source_en: The beauty of the scene made one instinctively fall still and listen to the low murmur of all creation.
units.source_zh: 秀丽的风景，不禁令人凝神细听万物低鸣。

paragraphs.source_zh: 秀丽的风景，不禁令人凝神细听万物低鸣。

paragraphs.source_en: “This place truly transcends the mortal world.” Tenkai said, “At a single glance, one may comprehend the source of earth, water, fire, and wind.” The Buddha taught that earth, water, fire, and wind together form the body, and that as causes and conditions flow, they bring forth differing fruits.

units.source_en: “This place truly transcends the mortal world.”
units.source_zh: “此处真乃超脱凡俗。”

units.source_en: Tenkai said, “At a single glance, one may comprehend the source of earth, water, fire, and wind.”
units.source_zh: 天海道，“一眼望去，便能明白地水火风之源。”

units.source_en: The Buddha taught that earth, water, fire, and wind together form the body, and that as causes and conditions flow, they bring forth differing fruits.
units.source_zh: 佛说，地水火风共成身，随波因缘招异果。

paragraphs.source_zh: “此处真乃超脱凡俗。”天海道，“一眼望去，便能明白地水火风之源。”佛说，地水火风共成身，随波因缘招异果。

paragraphs.source_en: By then, the blows of hammer and chisel from the construction had grown clearer still.

units.source_en: By then, the blows of hammer and chisel from the construction had grown clearer still.
units.source_zh: 此时，施工锤凿之音愈发清晰。

paragraphs.source_zh: 此时，施工锤凿之音愈发清晰。

paragraphs.source_en: At the Hour of the Boar on the nineteenth, Lord Ieyasu’s funeral was conducted according to Shinto rites.

units.source_en: At the Hour of the Boar on the nineteenth, Lord Ieyasu’s funeral was conducted according to Shinto rites.
units.source_zh: 十九日亥时，家康公葬礼依神道仪式举行。

paragraphs.source_zh: 十九日亥时，家康公葬礼依神道仪式举行。

paragraphs.source_en: Through the combined efforts of the town magistrate Hikosaka Kyūbei, Kuroyanagi Jugaku, and master carpenter Nakai Yamato-no-kami Masatsugu, a square sanctuary three ken across was completed by the evening of the nineteenth; even the torii, sacred enclosure, and lanterns had been made ready. Curtains were drawn on either side, and the twenty-five-ken approach before the sanctuary was covered with fresh rush mats to receive the coffin.

units.source_en: Through the combined efforts of the town magistrate Hikosaka Kyūbei, Kuroyanagi Jugaku, and master carpenter Nakai Yamato-no-kami Masatsugu, a square sanctuary three ken across was completed by the evening of the nineteenth; even the torii, sacred enclosure, and lanterns had been made ready.
units.source_zh: 在町奉行彦坂九兵卫、黑柳寿学和大工头中井大和守正次协力下，十九日傍晚，一个三间的四方殿堂落成，就连鸟居、井垣和灯笼亦都制好。

units.source_en: Curtains were drawn on either side, and the twenty-five-ken approach before the sanctuary was covered with fresh rush mats to receive the coffin.
units.source_zh: 左右拉上帷幔，殿堂前面二十五间的路上都铺了新草席，迎接灵柩。

paragraphs.source_zh: 在町奉行彦坂九兵卫、黑柳寿学和大工头中井大和守正次协力下，十九日傍晚，一个三间的四方殿堂落成，就连鸟居、井垣和灯笼亦都制好。左右拉上帷幔，殿堂前面二十五间的路上都铺了新草席，迎接灵柩。

paragraphs.source_en: Lord Ieyasu was by no means a man who held life cheaply. He had fought throughout his life, and many retainers had perished, yet he bestowed generous provision upon their surviving families and bloodlines. He did more than protect their descendants: he rebuked them, instructed them, treated all people with compassion, and defended them with an open heart.

units.source_en: Lord Ieyasu was by no means a man who held life cheaply.
units.source_zh: 家康公绝非不爱惜性命之人。

units.source_en: He had fought throughout his life, and many retainers had perished, yet he bestowed generous provision upon their surviving families and bloodlines. He did more than protect their descendants: he rebuked them, instructed them, treated all people with compassion, and defended them with an open heart.
units.source_zh: 他一生征战，家臣殒命甚多，但对其遗族血脉均予厚遗，非只为护其后人，他亦斥责之，教导之，厚道以待苍生，坦荡回护。

paragraphs.source_zh: 家康公绝非不爱惜性命之人。他一生征战，家臣殒命甚多，但对其遗族血脉均予厚遗，非只为护其后人，他亦斥责之，教导之，厚道以待苍生，坦荡回护。

paragraphs.source_en: Shogun Hidetada walked silently behind the hearse, and the senior retainers followed him in equal silence, every one of them reflecting upon Lord Ieyasu’s great aspiration.

units.source_en: Shogun Hidetada walked silently behind the hearse, and the senior retainers followed him in equal silence, every one of them reflecting upon Lord Ieyasu’s great aspiration.
units.source_zh: 将军秀忠默默跟于辕车后，重臣皆随秀忠默默而行，无不感念家康公大志。

paragraphs.source_zh: 将军秀忠默默跟于辕车后，重臣皆随秀忠默默而行，无不感念家康公大志。

paragraphs.source_en: How Lord Ieyasu’s extraordinary vision might flourish or decline in generations to come was now beyond his reach; those who followed would have battlefields and worlds of their own. Later generations would render their own judgment upon his achievements and faults, his rights and wrongs.

units.source_en: How Lord Ieyasu’s extraordinary vision might flourish or decline in generations to come was now beyond his reach; those who followed would have battlefields and worlds of their own.
units.source_zh: 家康公之卓绝志向，后世将会怎样消长，已非家康公所能鞭及，后人自有后人的疆场与天地。

units.source_en: Later generations would render their own judgment upon his achievements and faults, his rights and wrongs.
units.source_zh: 公之功过是非，后世自有评说。

paragraphs.source_zh: 家康公之卓绝志向，后世将会怎样消长，已非家康公所能鞭及，后人自有后人的疆场与天地。公之功过是非，后世自有评说。

paragraphs.source_en: The coffin was placed within the sanctuary, where an eternal lamp was lit. One offering for the deity, six dishes, and another thirty-six carefully chosen delicacies were laid before the spirit. Bonshun came before the spirit and performed the Three Consecrations and one hundred and twenty recitations of the Three Great Purifications. The voices of prayer rose and lingered through the night sky.

units.source_en: The coffin was placed within the sanctuary, where an eternal lamp was lit.
units.source_zh: 灵柩停于殿内，燃长明灯。

units.source_en: One offering for the deity, six dishes, and another thirty-six carefully chosen delicacies were laid before the spirit.
units.source_zh: 神供一份，菜六品，另精选三十六味，供奉灵前。

units.source_en: Bonshun came before the spirit and performed the Three Consecrations and one hundred and twenty recitations of the Three Great Purifications.
units.source_zh: 梵舜至灵前，进行三加持和三大祓百二十座。

units.source_en: The voices of prayer rose and lingered through the night sky.
units.source_zh: 祈祷之声缭缭回荡夜空。

paragraphs.source_zh: 灵柩停于殿内，燃长明灯。神供一份，菜六品，另精选三十六味，供奉灵前。梵舜至灵前，进行三加持和三大祓百二十座。祈祷之声缭缭回荡夜空。

paragraphs.source_en: Not the faintest breath of wind stirred upon the summit—a stillness rarely known in any age.

units.source_en: Not the faintest breath of wind stirred upon the summit—a stillness rarely known in any age.
units.source_zh: 山顶纹风不存，古今罕见。

paragraphs.source_zh: 山顶纹风不存，古今罕见。

paragraphs.source_en: All bowed their heads and bent low, hearing the words of prayer together with heaven and earth as they saw the lord depart this world…

units.source_en: All bowed their heads and bent low, hearing the words of prayer together with heaven and earth as they saw the lord depart this world…
units.source_zh: 众人垂首伏身，与天地同闻祈祷之词，送公归天……

paragraphs.source_zh: 众人垂首伏身，与天地同闻祈祷之词，送公归天……

paragraphs.source_en: Meanwhile, at Rinzai-ji, where he was staying temporarily, Tadateru sat motionless in a corner of his room, holding the flute his father had left him as grief welled up from within…

units.source_en: Meanwhile, at Rinzai-ji, where he was staying temporarily, Tadateru sat motionless in a corner of his room, holding the flute his father had left him as grief welled up from within…
units.source_zh: 与此同时，暂居于临济寺的忠辉静坐于房间一隅，手握父亲所遗笛子，悲从中起……

paragraphs.source_zh: 与此同时，暂居于临济寺的忠辉静坐于房间一隅，手握父亲所遗笛子，悲从中起……

paragraphs.source_en: Heaven and earth lay utterly silent. A solitary lamp burned in the room; its flame wavered, casting Tadateru’s lonely shadow upon the wall. He already knew of his father’s death, and knew as well that the funeral rites must now be drawing to their close.

units.source_en: Heaven and earth lay utterly silent.
units.source_zh: 天地万籁俱静。

units.source_en: A solitary lamp burned in the room; its flame wavered, casting Tadateru’s lonely shadow upon the wall.
units.source_zh: 房中孤灯一盏，灯焰摇晃，忠辉身影寂寂映于壁上。

units.source_en: He already knew of his father’s death, and knew as well that the funeral rites must now be drawing to their close.

ja.t: わろうとしていることも

units.source_zh: 他已知父亲之逝，亦知此时葬仪将尽。

paragraphs.source_zh: 天地万籁俱静。房中孤灯一盏，灯焰摇晃，忠辉身影寂寂映于壁上。他已知父亲之逝，亦知此时葬仪将尽。

paragraphs.source_en: Father has departed this life; let your son send you forth with one clear note of the flute. The thought arose in Tadateru’s mind, and he raised the flute to his lips, yet in his sorrow no sound came. All strength had left his body. What grievance did he bear in this life? On what could he rely in the life to come? Like a dream, like a flash of lightning—where was he to go?

units.source_en: Father has departed this life; let your son send you forth with one clear note of the flute.
units.source_zh: 父亲归天，孩儿以一声清笛相送。

units.source_zh: 忠辉心念一起，笛子横于唇边，却哀哀无声。

units.source_en: All strength had left his body. What grievance did he bear in this life?
units.source_zh: 他全身无力，今生何怨？

units.source_en: On what could he rely in the life to come?
units.source_zh: 往生何倚？

units.source_en: Like a dream, like a flash of lightning—where was he to go?

ja.t: のごとく――いったい、どこへ

units.source_zh: 如梦如电，将之何之？

paragraphs.source_zh: 父亲归天，孩儿以一声清笛相送。忠辉心念一起，笛子横于唇边，却哀哀无声。他全身无力，今生何怨？往生何倚？如梦如电，将之何之？

paragraphs.source_en: Above Rinzai-ji, the night sky blazed with stars.
